# Capitals whose token no create_country claims: the identity resolver has
# to fall through to the prescripted, custom-empire and bare routes.

prescripted_capital_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			save_global_event_target_as = fixture_prescripted
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_prescripted
		}
	}
}

custom_capital_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = custom_empire
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			save_global_event_target_as = fixture_custom
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_custom
		}
	}
}

bare_capital_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			save_global_event_target_as = fixture_bare
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_bare
		}
	}
}

# A second initializer setting the same star flag as fallen_home: writing a
# flag is not a reference, so neither may list the other.
beacon_twin_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	init_effect = {
		set_star_flag = fixture_beacon
	}
}

# A region marker written as a plain initializer flag list, not set_star_flag.
region_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	flags = { fixture_region }
}

# Targets saved on either side of the system's own scope.
scope_probe_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	init_effect = {
		set_star_flag = fixture_probe
	}
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			save_global_event_target_as = fixture_planet_target
			last_created_country = {
				save_global_event_target_as = fixture_country_target
			}
		}
	}
}

# A guardian: its country is named in a last_created_country sibling of the
# create_country block, the way vanilla's leviathans write it.
guardian_capital_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			create_country = {
				name = "NAME_Fixture_Guardian"
				type = guardian
				flag = {
					colors = { "fixture_red" "null" "null" "null" }
				}
			}
			last_created_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_modifier = fixture_power } }
					add_modifier = { modifier = fixture_power days = -1 }
				}
				save_global_event_target_as = fixture_guardian
				set_country_flag = fixture_guardian
			}
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_guardian
		}
	}
}
